entries.decision: No finding-specific runtime matcher. The German/English IP-allocation conflict is source-context knowledge, not an observable DNS-SD advertisement condition.
guards: do not infer document language/source from a device advertisement
do not enforce universal ZeroConf or 169.254 solely from this finding
do not duplicate normative DNS-SD checks as Known-Issues heuristics

entries.decision: No finding-specific runtime matcher. The RFC 2927/3927 defect is a documentation-reference correction and does not identify a runtime packet or advertisement state.
guards: do not emit packet/runtime warnings merely because link-local addressing is observed
do not turn RFC 3927 into a universal VDV requirement

entries.decision: No finding-specific runtime matcher. Missing V2.3 German table rows are a historical documentation omission; actual V2.2+ DNS-SD key checks are already implemented from the independent runtime profile.
